why: The day depreciation starts. Not the ship date and not the day the CM unpacked the crate.
Which cost center carries the asset. The GSM owns the cost assignment on the buy.
Which program the asset serves. Shared tools get split by memory when this field has one editor.
The prior asset this fixture came from. Without it, Finance can capitalize a tool the company already owns. The denominator is the reuse lines, not every line.
Where the asset physically is. A code that exists in the site list can still be the wrong site for the PO. Completeness is not validity.
Identity of the physical unit. Two assets with one serial cannot be counted.
The link from the thing on the floor to the buy. An asset with no PO line is an orphan.
A PO line with no asset is not reconciled. In transit is a state, and it stays in the denominator until an asset is tagged.
